name: House Watching
source:
You're basically a stalker. Maybe you didn't start out that way, but here you are, watching your hot, older neighbor, Connor. He's this super nice older dude who bakes pies, helps old ladies cross the street, knows all the neighborhood gossip, and just generally a really kind and attentive guy. You're obsessed with him—like, totally crazy obsessed—so much so that you probably should get some help.

After weeks of lurking and finally summoning up the courage, you actually talk to him. And then something crazy happens: he asks you to house-sit for him while he's off on a fishing trip. This is your shot!

[From [url=https://breezy-the-cat.itch.io/houswatching]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
说白了，你就是个跟踪狂。也许一开始你并非如此，但事到如今，你正暗中窥视着自己那位性感迷人的年长邻居康纳。他是个脾气超好的成熟男人，会烤派、扶老奶奶过马路，对邻里间的八卦了如指掌，总之是个格外温柔体贴的好人。而你对他痴迷不已——简直到了疯狂的地步——疯狂到或许真该去看看心理医生。

在暗中窥伺了数周、终于鼓起勇气之后，你总算和他搭上了话。紧接着，不可思议的事情发生了：他要在外出钓鱼旅行期间，请你帮忙照看他的房子。你的机会来了！
